title: Team
description: A group of people who own things — the unit every team field points at. Backstage kind: Group (type team / org-unit / org-division; parent → spec.parent, children and members derived).

type.title: Type
type.description: Where this group sits in the org: a delivery team, an org unit grouping teams, or a division grouping units (the Group type dictionary).

email.title: Email
email.description: The group mailbox or distribution list.

parent.title: Parent team
parent.description: The group this one belongs to; empty for the top of the org tree.
